title: Donald B. Gillies Lecture: Dr. Michael Stonebraker
channel: Siebel School of Computing and Data Science
summary: Turing Award winner Michael Stonebraker gives the 2018 Donald B. Gillies Memorial Lecture at Illinois. He discusses the gap between academic research and industry problems, publishing incentives, and the influence of large industry users on research.
why: Cited in many threads about academic incentives, paper counts and why academia struggles to produce working software.

quote.text: There's a lot more, I highly recommend the talk!
